name: Spellbook
summary: AI contract review and drafting tool for transactional lawyers, working inside Microsoft Word.
description: Spellbook is an AI tool for transactional lawyers that works as a Microsoft Word add-in. It redlines contracts and flags risks, drafts clauses from scratch or saved libraries, compares terms to market standards, answers questions and applies firm playbooks, with multi-document workflows. A seven-day free trial is offered and pricing is custom; academic institutions can get free access. It is SOC 2 Type II compliant, according to the site.
